moat_against: ROIC proxy only 5.82% / 6.98% / 4.48% / 5.22% / 6.86% in FY21-FY25 — below cost of capital, weighed down by acquisition goodwill
Continuing revenue grew only +1.9% in FY2025; FY2026 core guidance ~4%
Cyclical hardware/instrument demand exposed to tariffs, healthcare policy and government spending
Gross-margin pressure from product mix and tariffs flagged through 2026
moat_for: Fluke's dominant position in electrical test/calibration with installed-base service and consumables pull-through
ASP sterilization and Provation/Censis workflow software embedded in hospital processes — switching costs and regulatory lock-in
~50% recurring revenue from software, services and consumables
Gross margin 63.50% in FY2025 (64.18% FY24) — pricing power in the continuing portfolio
moat_justification: Leading niche brands (Fluke, ASP, Provation) with installed-base consumables, service and workflow-software switching costs and ~50% recurring revenue, but ROIC proxy printed only 4.48-6.98% in FY21-FY25 (below cost of capital, goodwill-heavy) and organic growth is low-single-digit — a 7+ moat is not supported on this record.
name: Fortive Corporation
one_liner: Quality niche industrial-tech compounder, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% at $57.40 (7.8% weighted IRR, IV@15% $24.12); it clears 15% only below ~$24.
